Joey's Song Freezing Man 2027 On January 9th, Rock n Roll Hall of Famers, Grammy Winners, and legendary artists are coming together on one stage in Madison, Wisconsin for a one of a kind, never before seen concert experience unlike anything else happening in live music today. This is not a tribute show. This is not a nostalgia tour. One night. One cause. One room you will never forget being in.

This is not a tribute show. This is not a nostalgia tour. One night. One cause. One room you will never forget being in. The Joey's Song Freezing Man Concerts is a 100% volunteer organization so every penny we net goes to finding treatments and cures for Epilepsy. Join us for the ONLY major music festival in the world that fights epilepsy. And it's right here in Madison! Joey's Song was established in memory of Joey Gomoll who died just shy of his fifth birthday after battling epilepsy his entire life.
